description: Get the current/last-known position of an in-air flight: latitude, longitude, altitude, groundspeed, heading and timestamp. The `id` must be an AeroAPI fa_flight_id (from flightaware_flight_status). Example: flightaware_flight_position({ id: "UAL123-1234567890-airline-0123", _apiKey: "your-key" })

id.description: AeroAPI fa_flight_id (from flightaware_flight_status). A bare flight number/tail number will NOT work here — this endpoint needs the fa_flight_id.

name: flightaware_flight_position
title: Flightaware Flight Position
